notes.title: 🔴 LIVE (Steam Next Fest) #2
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Next Fest is here and so am I![/h1]

Watch the Hot Heat Reset livestream with me, the developer, and ask me anything in the chat box. I'll be doing multiple runs of the demo showing off every single feature the game has to offer!

I'll try to get an A* grade on all levels ;)

The stream starts,
February 7, 2023 6:00 PM PT
February 8, 2023 7:30 AM IST

Set a reminder, install the demo and add Hot Heat Reset to your Wishlist!
